(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A speaker comprising a permanent magnet (2), and a coil (8) positioned around the permanent magnet and attached to a membrane (10), wherein the membrane (10) comprises an elastomer of thickness less than 0.3mm and with a Young's modulus below __75 MPa__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: A speaker as claimed in claim 1, wherein the elastomer (10) comprises __at least one of silicone, rubber, or other flexible materials__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: A speaker as claimed in any preceding claim, wherein the membrane (10) comprises a flat central region and a supporting edge region, and wherein the speaker further comprises a stiffening element (16) on the flat central region on the opposite side of the membrane (10) to the coil (8), wherein the __stiffening element (16) is configured to enhance structural integrity without substantially increasing mass__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 10: A method of manufacturing a speaker, comprising: forming a membrane (10) from an elastomer, wherein the membrane has thickness less than 0.3mm and a Young's modulus below __75 MPa__; attaching a coil (8) to the membrane; and assembling the speaker by suspending the membrane (10), such that the coil (8) is positioned around a permanent magnet (2) and __wherein the method includes the step of optimizing the elastomer composition for desired acoustic performance__.
